title: Публичные решения агентов: проверенные результаты, версии и прочитанные фрагменты
scope: Целевой обзор первичных публичных источников. Не исчерпывающий поиск всех репозиториев. Скачанный код не запускался, обращения к языковым моделям не выполнялись.
limitations: Pinned default-branch commit is not necessarily the exact submitted competition image.
Directory/tree indexing does not mean code was read.
No local reproduction of third-party scores.
Missing repository license must not be treated as permission to copy source.
Research hypotheses are not measured improvements of our agent.

local_rules.clarification: Third-party Python packages are not globally prohibited. Packages are installed at image build and count toward 4GB; no downloads at run; local neural models prohibited. Task-specific restrictions can be stricter.
